name: loopbreaker
description: Shape, plan, implement, and review software against a local behavior contract with bounded review and explicit shipping decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded agent delivery from shaping through review
interface.longDescription: Four reusable delivery skills share one local SQLite and MCP behavior contract, keeping implementation scope frozen, evidence attributable, review bounded, and shipping decisions explicit.
defaultPrompt: Shape this idea into a bounded product bet
Plan this feature as an executable behavior contract
Review this change without starting a review loop
